# Vocabulary: mechanic_family

Primary functional family of a mechanic. Exactly one per mechanic. Assign by the state the mechanic owns, not by the genre it appears in.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `resources-production` | Resources & production | Stocks of goods and the rules that create, convert, store, or destroy them. |
| `logistics-networks` | Logistics & networks | Movement of goods, people, energy, or service coverage across space or graphs. |
| `economy-finance` | Economy & finance | Money, prices, markets, debt, and valuation. |
| `agents-behavior` | Agents & behavior | Individual agents' needs, decisions, schedules, skills, and internal states. |
| `social-relations` | Social relations | Pairwise and group relationships, reputation, factions, conversation, and norms. |
| `population-lineage` | Population & lineage | Birth, death, aging, migration, inheritance, and population structure. |
| `governance-policy` | Governance & policy | Laws, policies, elections, legitimacy, and institutional rules. |
| `space-construction` | Space & construction | Placement, zoning, layout, terrain, and built structure. |
| `physics-materials` | Physics & materials | Forces, motion, materials, fluids, heat, and destruction. |
| `environment-ecology` | Environment & ecology | Weather, seasons, ecosystems, contagion, pollution, and hydrology. |
| `biology-health` | Biology & health | Bodies, injury, disease, survival meters, and creature care. |
| `time-pacing` | Time & pacing | How simulated time advances and how the player controls it. |
| `information-legibility` | Information & legibility | How simulation state is revealed, hidden, summarized, or explained to the player. |
| `control-automation` | Control & automation | How player intent is expressed, delegated, or automated. |
| `progression-goals` | Progression & goals | Unlocks, research, milestones, and scenario structure. |
| `risk-failure` | Risk & failure | Disasters, threats, degradation, and fail states. |
| `narrative-generation` | Narrative & generation | Event selection, story structure, dialogue, and runtime content generation. |
| `world-generation` | World generation | Procedural creation of maps, histories, and initial conditions. |
| `multiplayer-persistence` | Multiplayer & persistence | Shared worlds, player-to-player interaction, content sharing, and modding. |
| `conflict-defense` | Conflict & defense | Combat, raids, military units, and defense. |
| `operation-procedure` | Operation & procedure | Hands-on procedural tasks, tool use, and embodied skill. |
